answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 2807 Country: India Title: I woke up in the morning and offered fajar prayer in the mosque after doing ablution.Later I came to know that I had a nightfall.I want to know whether I have to repeat the prayer and is any sin in offering prayer witout gusul while not being aware of it. Question: I woke up in the morning and offered fajar prayer in the mosque after doing ablution.Later I came to know that I had a nightfall.I want to know whether I have to repeat the prayer and is any sin in offering prayer witout gusul while not being aware of it. Answer ID: 2807 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 87/87=L) Yes, you have to remake your Fajr salah ; وجد فی ثوبہ منیاً او بولاً اعاد من آخر احتلام و بول و رعاف ( الدر المختار مع الشامی 1/378 ) , but you will not be sinful for praying the salah in ignorance with impurity since the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) said: 'My Ummah will not be answerable for the actions they commit in ignorance'. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
